title: 第十七章 放学后别走第十八章 弱太弱
content_zh:
王腾一脸无辜，事不关己的样子，让许杰和余浩再次哈哈大笑。
白薇正使劲憋着笑，憋的非常辛苦。
结果他们一笑，她就再也憋不住了，噗嗤一声和两人笑成了一团。
李荣成这两天心情很不好。
昨天他去蔷薇酒吧玩耍，顺便撩上两个社会小姐姐，去酒店聊聊人生谈谈理想。
眼看着小姐姐就要撩上了，一群小瘪三破门而入，大喊了一声。
“哪个是李荣成？有种滚出来！”
李荣成当时那个气啊，哗啦一下就站起来，大骂道：“老子就是李荣成，哪家狗链子没栓牢，把你们这几只疯狗放了出来。”
那群人也是气的七窍生烟，不管三七二十一，冲上来就把李荣成套了麻袋。
李荣成大概没想到，这一群人竟然都是初级，或者中级武徒。
他虽然是一个高级武徒，但面对这一群初级和中级的武徒，却是双拳难敌四手。
何况他没想到对方真敢直接动手，措不及防，同时也是经验不足，瞬间就着了道。
那群人把李荣成打晕，带到了一个废旧仓库。
阴鸷青年赵钢豹正在那里等着，一见李荣成被绑了过来，麻袋都没打开，就招呼手下小弟上去一通胖揍。
打完了，才打开麻袋。
这一瞅，人不对啊！
一群人面面相觑，赵钢豹更是气的大骂，然后把气全都发泄到李荣成身上。
接下来，又是一顿惨不忍睹的胖揍。
那一刻，李荣成完全是懵逼的。
我是谁？我在哪儿？我要到哪儿去？

赵钢豹等人发泄一通，就走人了，留下李荣成仰面躺在废旧仓库的地面上，流下了委屈又无助的眼泪。
自始至终，他都不知道到底发生了什么事？
后来他颤抖着手，掏出手机，打了120，这才被送到医院急救。
幸好只是外伤，而且李荣成是高级武徒，体质比普通人强好几倍，伤势恢复的快。
所以他今天才能活蹦乱跳来学校上学。
不过他心里始终窝着一股火，看谁都不顺眼。
一个早上过去，每个同学看到他的样子，都是一脸怪异，想笑又不敢笑。
几个暗地里偷笑的同学，都被他狠揍了一顿。
这会儿他来食堂吃饭，结果一上楼，就听到一阵笑声，心里的火瞬间就冒了出来。
气的他脸色一阵发青。
“特玛的！
笑什么笑！”
李荣成气势汹汹的冲着王腾几人走了过来。
content_en:
Wang Teng looked innocent and had nothing to do with him, making Xu Jie and Yu Hao laugh again.
Bai Wei was trying her best to hold back her laughter, which was very hard.
As soon as they laughed, she couldn't hold it in any longer and burst into laughter with the two of them.
Li Rongcheng has been in a bad mood these past two days.
Yesterday, he went to Qiangwei Bar to play, and by the way, he picked up two social ladies, and went to the hotel to chat about life and ideals.
Just as the young lady was about to be seduced, a group of young losers broke in and shouted.
"Who is Li Rongcheng? Get out of here if you dare!"
Li Rongcheng was so angry at that time that he stood up with a crash and cursed: "I am Li Rongcheng. Whose dog chain was not fastened tightly and let you crazy dogs out?"
The group of people were also furious, and regardless of what happened, they rushed up and put Li Rongcheng in a sack.
Li Rongcheng probably didn't expect that this group of people would all be junior or intermediate martial arts disciples.
Although he is a high-level martial arts disciple, facing this group of junior and intermediate martial arts disciples, it is difficult for him to defeat them with just two fists.
What's more, he didn't expect that the other party would dare to take action directly. He was caught off guard and lacked experience, so he was caught instantly.
The group of people knocked Li Rongcheng unconscious and took him to an abandoned warehouse.
Zhao Gangbao, a sinister young man, was waiting there. When he saw Li Rongcheng being tied up without opening the sack, he called his subordinates to come up and beat him up.
After the beating, I opened the sack.
This look is wrong!
A group of people looked at each other, Zhao Gangbao even cursed angrily, and then vented all his anger on Li Rongcheng.
Next, there was another brutal beating.
At that moment, Li Rongcheng was completely confused.
who I am? Where am I? Where am I going?
Zhao Gangbao and others vented their feelings and left, leaving Li Rongcheng lying on his back on the ground of the abandoned warehouse, shedding tears of grievance and helplessness.
From beginning to end, he didn't know what happened?
Later, with trembling hands, he took out his mobile phone and called 120 before being sent to the hospital for emergency treatment.
Fortunately, it was only a traumatic injury, and Li Rongcheng was a high-level martial arts disciple. His physique was several times stronger than that of ordinary people, and he recovered quickly from his injuries.
That's why he can come to school alive and kicking today.
But there was always a fire in his heart, and he didn't like anyone.
One morning passed, every classmate looked weird when they saw him, wanting to laugh but not daring to.
Several classmates who were secretly laughing were severely beaten by him.
Now he came to the cafeteria to eat, but as soon as he went upstairs, he heard a burst of laughter, and the fire in his heart burst out instantly.
His face turned blue with anger.
“Tema’s!
Why are you laughing? "
Li Rongcheng came over to Wang Teng and the others menacingly.
